identity: Professional green with warm gold and natural stone support.
domain_style: Professional-green buyer feedback with warm-gold context and natural-stone storefront surfaces.

panels.label: Transient toast
panels.specimen: Floating neutral branded toast with small success icon, text "Quote request sent", quiet caption "Sample confirmed response". Board note "Show on the destination". No Undo or action claiming acceptance/order placement.

panels.label: Inline notice
panels.specimen: Compact quote form excerpt, empty field labelled "Quantity" and error icon/message "Enter a valid quantity". Notice heading "Check quantity". Board note "Keep entered details". No sample numeric quantity, prices, or hidden-field error.

panels.label: Persistent banner
panels.specimen: Storefront notice with pause icon, heading "Store paused", body "This store is not taking orders right now. You can still browse." Small board note "Keep visible while paused". No dismiss X, Resume, or invented recovery link.

panels.label: Accessible updates
panels.specimen: Explicitly labelled "Announcement design". A small speaker-outline row with quoted text "Quote request sent". Two simple rule rows "Announce once" and "Keep destination focus". Warm-gold annotation "Polite update / no duplicate announcement". This is a design annotation, not a screen-reader transcript.

feedback_contract: A toast confirms a short nonessential event; it is not the sole location for unresolved errors, restrictions or review state.
Inline notices belong to their affected form/record/action, preserve entered data and use safe reason-specific copy.
Persistent banners remain while their condition applies. Dismiss only when a supported nonessential notice may be hidden; do not resolve a condition by dismissal.
Toast, inline error and persistent condition are independent examples. Do not present contradictory success and failure as one live outcome.
Confirm the authoritative operation outcome before success. Local cart update, proof upload, review submission and case action have distinct scopes.
No fictional Undo, blind mutation Retry or instant approval/paid/order completion. Unknown outcome requires reconciliation before retry.
One in-flight action per scope, disabled labelled pending control, no duplicate taps; clear progress in finally/unmount/account change.
Use the existing shared helper or documented app equivalent. Future adoption should adapt canonical semantics rather than create duplicate helper classes.
Announcements are meaningful, concise, coalesced by event/entity revision and ordinarily polite. Inspect native SnackBar semantics before wrapping another live region.
Keep focus in context; announcements do not steal focus. Validation focus follows C10; route focus follows C07. Label dismiss/recovery controls and exclude decorative icon semantics.
Timeouts must allow reading and assistive use; actionable notices need accessible duration policy. Reduced motion uses static feedback; haptics are supplementary.
Use C01 locked app identity and status pairs; text/icon/action convey meaning beyond color. Check rendered light/dark, contrast, scaling, localisation and platform AT later.
implementation_status: Design assets/docs only. No app/package runtime, pubspec, navigation or backend changed by this task.
limits: Raster proposals; no runtime/accessibility certification or pixel-exact color/geometry claim.
